notes.title: Demo version is already available!
notes.notes:
During the Steam Festival, you can play a demo version of our game. All brothers will have access to the prologue and the fool game. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a cozy chamber party, show everyone who is in charge here. Do not forget to help the author with nishtyaks and add the game to your wishlist. Soon there will be a full-fledged version of the game, where you can reveal all your talents!

notes.title: Ultimate Muscle Roller Championship
notes.notes:
Take part in an incredible racing championship, among the most pumped up guys from all over the world.
To begin with, you have to choose a partner for yourself, team up with him and start working together for the most productive use of the vehicle, when using which everything depends on you!
When you decide on a partner and a vehicle, it's time for exciting races in completely different settings, from a hot American beach to an antique coliseum.

Link to the game - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1818410/Ultimate_Muscle_Roller_Championship/
